events.continuity_hook: Closes the central Pennsylvania trip with site-entry and return-day logistics after the reservations were booked.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm paperwork timing, hotel arrival note, plant-gate instructions, rental-car fueling, and the Thursday airport buffer without changing the booked itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: The utility sends the visitor packet and clarifies that Jonah should use the contractor gate for a 6:45 a.m. safety check before the 7:00 a.m. membrane startup review. The Tuesday afternoon one-stop to Harrisburg, compact SUV, and plant-area hotel stay remain unchanged, but he needs the visitor form, late-arrival hotel note, Wednesday morning departure time, Thursday procurement-meeting exit plan, and fuel stop before the airport tightened. The only unresolved item is whether the contractor or the utility front desk issues his badge.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a distributor-training episode after the Pennsylvania commissioning visit is wrapped.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist around the training start, demo-case logistics, reasonable connection quality, hotel rating, parking, and evening dining access.
events.scenario_brief: A distributor in Lenexa asks Jonah to lead a winterization training for operators and service reps, with a Wednesday 8:30 a.m. classroom start and a possible Thursday morning contractor breakfast. He needs Tuesday Bay Area-to-Kansas City flight options that leave after an internal morning forecast call but still allow rental-car pickup, slide cleanup, and a quick check of the demo case at the branch. Hotel options should compare a well-rated Lenexa business hotel near the distributor and restaurants against a cheaper airport-area stay that adds a longer morning drive. Open items are whether the demo case ships on time and whether the Thursday breakfast stays on the calendar.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Kansas City training plan once freight timing and the earlier classroom setup requirement are known.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the outbound flight, hotel choice, rental-car timing, and Wednesday-versus-Thursday return plan before booking.
events.scenario_brief: The distributor confirms the demo case will arrive at the Lenexa branch by Tuesday noon, but the Wednesday class expands and now needs Jonah onsite by 7:45 a.m. for room setup. He wants to narrow between a Tuesday afternoon nonstop on a non-United carrier that lands earlier and a United one-stop that preserves loyalty credit but leaves less time for the rental car and hotel check-in. The Lenexa hotel remains the better operational fit if parking, breakfast timing, coffee maker, mini-fridge, and nearby dinner choices check out; the open decision is whether to return Wednesday night after a customer dinner or stay until Thursday morning.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Kansas City distributor-training trip from comparison to booked itinerary after the final schedule pieces settle.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, rental car, hotel reservation, room notes, seat choices, and the training-day timeline.
events.scenario_brief: The customer dinner is set for Wednesday evening and the distributor no longer needs Jonah for the Thursday breakfast, so he can return Thursday without rushing out after dinner. He books the Tuesday afternoon nonstop that gives the cleanest arrival, reserves a compact SUV, and chooses the Lenexa hotel with strong guest feedback, parking, breakfast, in-room coffee maker, mini-fridge, and nearby restaurants. The return is set for Thursday midday with a comfortable schedule back to the Bay Area, and window seats are selected where available.

events.continuity_hook: Shifts from work travel to a personal weekend once Jonah’s distributor trip is complete.
events.interaction_goal: Create a concise flight, hotel, and rental-car comparison for a Friday-to-Sunday or Friday-to-Monday Palm Springs weekend.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah and his spouse want a low-effort winter long weekend in Palm Springs after several work trips, with Friday travel from the Bay Area and a Sunday or Monday return depending on whether she can take the extra day off. They want to compare flying into Palm Springs against Ontario with a longer drive, and look at well-reviewed downtown or Uptown hotels with walkable dinner options, a quieter room, and a pool area rather than workday-oriented room details. The open items are whether Monday is available, whether a rental car is worth it for one desert hike, and how much more they are willing to pay for the easier airport.

events.continuity_hook: Finalizes the Palm Springs weekend after the return date and hotel availability are confirmed.
events.interaction_goal: Book the flights, hotel, and rental car, add the quiet-room note, select adjacent seats, and summarize the Friday arrival and Monday return timing.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah's spouse confirms Monday off, and the better-rated downtown Palm Springs hotel still has a refundable quiet king room available. They choose the Palm Springs airport routing over Ontario to avoid the extra drive, add a compact rental car for one hiking day and dinner flexibility, and set the Monday return after checkout rather than an early-morning departure. Seat selection prioritizes sitting together, with a window only if it does not split them up.
